article.title: Is this the market working or the market failing?
article.excerpt: A Twitter battle over the size of each “nuclear button” possessed by President Donald Trump and North Korea’s Kim Jong-un has spiked sales of a drug that protects against radiation poisoning. Troy Jones, who runs the website www.nukepills.com , said demand for potassium iodide soared last week, after Trump tweeted that he had a “much bigger & more powerful”
